card.text: Explore Despina through its Voyager-derived shape model.

introduction.text: Despina is a small, irregular moon inside Neptune’s faint ring system. Voyager images constrain its overall shape, but do not provide reliable surface mapping at this scale.

model.title: Approximate shape model
model.summary: Shape estimated from Voyager images. Its outline is measured, but local terrain is unresolved; gray grid: no imagery.
